description:
Block or unblock one caller for the agent they called. Blocking stops that person calling the agent: not from its share link, its website widget, the app, or by phone. They are told only that they cannot call. Confirm with the user before blocking someone. Set blocked to false to unblock them, which lets them call again. Other agents on the account are not affected.

Requires scope `calls:write`.

blocked.description: true to block this caller, false to unblock them.

id.description: The caller id, from list_callers or a call's caller.id.

name: update_caller
title: Block or unblock a caller
